positions.subject: q:education/sfusd-limit-screens-and-ai
positions.summary: Cheung does not support routine student use of generative AI during classroom instruction, except as an accessibility support, and supports age-appropriate AI and digital literacy instruction.

citations.quote: I do not support routine use of generative AI by students during classroom instruction, particularly for younger students, except as an appropriate accessibility support.
But we cannot prepare students for the future by pretending AI does not exist.

positions.subject: q:education/sfusd-spend-reserves
positions.summary: Cheung supports keeping the legally required reserve plus a stabilization reserve, and says reserves should not keep growing while classrooms are understaffed.

citations.quote: I support maintaining the legally required reserve plus a prudent stabilization reserve based on clearly identified risks and future obligations. But reserves should not grow indefinitely while classrooms are understaffed and students go without services.
